name: Sebastianskapelle Ladenburg: guided tour
description: 30-minute tour of the former episcopal court chapel with medieval wall paintings
details:
A short tour by the Heimatbund Ladenburg of the Sebastianskapelle, the former court chapel of the bishops of Worms. Its oldest foundations date to the early 11th century; the choir and most wall paintings are from the second half of the 15th century, the altars from an 18th-century renovation.

The altars are covered during current restoration work. Meeting point at the chapel entrance in the Amtshof; 5 EUR, 1 EUR of it goes to the restoration of the wall paintings.
